-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies OAuth credentials and connectivity.

create-document.name: create-document
create-document.description: Create a new Google Doc with a title and optional initial content. Returns the document ID and URL.

params.title: Title of the new Google Doc
params.content: Optional initial text content for the document. Supports \n for line breaks.

read-document.name: read-document
read-document.description: Read content from a Google Docs document.

update-document.name: update-document
update-document.description: Replace all occurrences of a text string in a Google Doc. Useful for updating placeholders or specific content.

insert-text.name: insert-text
insert-text.description: Insert text at a specific position in a Google Doc. Index 1 is the start of the document.

params.index: Position to insert at (1 = start of document). Use read-document to find positions.

append-text.name: append-text
append-text.description: Append text to the end of a Google Doc.

batch-update-document.name: batch-update-document
batch-update-document.description: Perform multiple operations on a Google Doc in a single atomic request. Supports insert, delete, and replace operations.

name: Google Docs
description: Create, read, and edit Google Docs documents - create, read content, insert text, append text, find & replace, batch updates. To delete a document, use the Google Drive MCA.
